response.original_title: Seth MacFarlane's Cavalcade of Cartoon Comedy: Red Carpet Premere
response.overview: A DVD/Blu-ray extra. It documents the actual premiere event for the adult animated web series of short, non-sequitur cartoon sketches (in the style of Family Guy cutaways, but even more uncensored). The event took place on September 9, 2008, at the Palihouse Holloway in West Hollywood, California, hosted in association with Media Rights Capital (the series’ production partner). The series itself launched online the next day (September 10, 2008) on YouTube/SethComedy, initially sponsored by Burger King.  Notable attendees captured in photos and the featurette Seth MacFarlane, Seth Green, James Kyson Lee (Heroes), Rachel Sterling (Pussycat Dolls), Ken Davitian, Media Rights Capital co-CEOs Modi Wiczyk and Asif Satchu, and others. Some costumed characters from the cartoons also appeared.
response.title: Seth MacFarlane's Cavalcade of Cartoon Comedy: Red Carpet Premere
